# truenas_init_script (Resource)

Runs a command or script at `PREINIT`, `POSTINIT` or `SHUTDOWN`. Set `command` when `type` is `COMMAND` and `script` when it is `SCRIPT`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) Type of init/shutdown script to execute.

* `COMMAND`: Execute a single command
* `SCRIPT`: Execute a script file
- `when` (String) * "PREINIT": Early in the boot process before all services have started.
* "POSTINIT": Late in the boot process when most services have started.
* "SHUTDOWN": On shutdown.

### Optional

- `command` (String) Must be given if `type="COMMAND"`. Defaults to `""`.
- `comment` (String) Optional comment describing the purpose of this script. Defaults to `""`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the init/shutdown script is enabled to execute. Defaults to `true`.
- `script` (String) Must be given if `type="SCRIPT"`. Defaults to `""`.
- `timeout` (Number) An integer time in seconds that the system should wait for the execution of the script/command.

A hard limit for a timeout is configured by the base OS, so when a script/command is set to execute on SHUTDOWN,     the hard limit configured by the base OS is changed adding the timeout specified by script/command so it can be     ensured that it executes as desired and is not interrupted by the base OS's limit. Defaults to `10`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Identifier assigned by TrueNAS.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to       = truenas_init_script.example
  provider = truenas
  identity = {
    id = 1
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (Number) Identifier assigned by TrueNAS.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by TrueNAS id
terraform import truenas_init_script.example 1
```
